title: Google Play Store packaging readiness for IBN PWA (TWA) — frontend assets & guide updates

requirements.summary: Serve a static Digital Asset Links file at `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` with placeholders for TWA verification.
acceptanceCriteria: A file exists at `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json` and is served at `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` by the deployed app.
The JSON is valid and includes the standard `delegate_permission/common.handle_all_urls` relation with placeholders/instructions for `package_name` and `sha256_cert_fingerprints`.
No backend changes are required to serve the file (it is a static asset).

file_operations.description: Create a valid Digital Asset Links JSON file for TWA with `relation: ["delegate_permission/common.handle_all_urls"]` and clear placeholder/instruction text for `target.android_app.package_name` and `target.android_app.sha256_cert_fingerprints` values.

requirements.summary: Update the in-app Play Store publishing guide with a concrete Bubblewrap/PWABuilder checklist referencing manifest and assetlinks URLs.
acceptanceCriteria: The Play Store publishing guide mentions `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` and explains that the values must be filled in after choosing a package name and signing key.
The guide explicitly references `{window.location.origin}/manifest.webmanifest` as the manifest input and keeps all user-facing text in English.
The section remains accessible from the existing landing page flow (no broken imports/routes).

file_operations.description: Revise the existing 'Publish to Google Play Store' content into a concrete step-by-step checklist for Bubblewrap/PWABuilder including: manifest input as `${window.location.origin}/manifest.webmanifest`, Digital Asset Links hosted path `/.well-known/assetlinks.json`, and guidance that `package_name` and `sha256_cert_fingerprints` are filled after selecting package name + signing key. Keep all user-facing text in English. Use existing shadcn-ui building blocks already imported (Card/Alert/Button) to present the checklist; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure required Play Store listing images exist under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` and are referenced appropriately (manifest icons + guide feature graphic path).
acceptanceCriteria: The required images exist under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` with the exact filenames specified in this build request.
`frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest` continues to reference the 192x192 and 512x512 icons under `/assets/generated/`.
The Play Store guide references `/assets/generated/ibn-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png` as the feature graphic location.

file_operations.description: Add the required generated app icon asset file at `frontend/public/assets/generated/ibn-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` (static Play Store / launcher icon).
Add the required generated app icon asset file at `frontend/public/assets/generated/ibn-app-icon.dim_512x512.png` (static Play Store / launcher icon).
Add the required generated Play feature graphic asset file at `frontend/public/assets/generated/ibn-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png` (static Play Store listing graphic).

Verify/maintain that the manifest continues to reference `/assets/generated/ibn-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/ibn-app-icon.dim_512x512.png` for the 192x192 and 512x512 icons (no changes beyond ensuring correctness).

Update the Play Store publishing guide text to explicitly reference the feature graphic file location as `/assets/generated/ibn-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png`. Use existing shadcn-ui content structure already in this section; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add the Play Store feature graphic to the service worker precache list without changing caching strategy or offline fallback behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing precache entries and network-first behavior remain intact.
The app still serves `offline.html` as a navigation fallback when offline.

file_operations.description: Add `/assets/generated/ibn-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png` to the existing `PRECACHE_ASSETS` list. Keep the current network-first fetch handling and the `offline.html` navigation fallback unchanged.
